basic_details.job_title: BEE Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Sector Expert, Project Engineer Posts
basic_details.short_information: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) has announced 5 vacancies for Sector Expert (S&L Division), Sector Expert (ADEETIE), Sector Expert (ECSBC/Buildings), Sector Expert (Artificial Intelligence) and Project Engineer (NECA) posts on a contractual basis. Qualification and eligibility requirements vary by post. Selected candidates will receive pay ranging from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,00,000. Eligible applicants can apply through the offline application process by sending the prescribed application form by post to Secretary, Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Ministry of Power, Govt. of India, 4th Floor, Sewa

how_to_apply: Fill out the application form in the prescribed proforma provided in Annexure-I of the notification.
Attach two passport-size photographs along with self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, and other relevant supporting documents.
Enclose BEE Auditor/Manager certificates or valid score cards if applicable.
Forward the complete application within 45 days of the advertisement publication in Employment News on or before 17-11-2026.
Send the application by post to the Secretary, Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Ministry of Power, Govt. of India, 4th Floor, Sewa Bhawan, R. K. Puram, Sector-1, New Delhi – 110066.

rows.details: Ministry of Power, Govt. of India
Standards & Labelling, ADEETIE, ECSBC/Buildings, Artificial Intelligence, and National Exam Coordinator (NECA)
Purely contractual / co-terminus (Annual renewal based on satisfactory performance)
Sector Expert (S&L Division), Sector Expert (ADEETIE), Sector Expert (ECSBC/Buildings), Sector Expert (Artificial Intelligence), and Project Engineer (National Exam Coordinator – NECA)
Rs. 1,00,000/- per month (for Sector Expert posts) and Rs. 60,000/- per month (for Project Engineer)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The Bureau of Energy Efficiency has notified a total of 05 contractual vacancies across various divisions:

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology with Minimum 60% marks or Equivalent grade from a Recognized University/Institution AND Postgraduate/Master's degree in Engineering/Technology/Energy Planning/Energy Management/Sustainable Energy/Environmental Studies/Environment Science. Minimum 05 years' post-qualification domain experience in Energy Management/Operations & Maintenance/technical evaluation of Energy Savings/Standards for appliances and equipment, promotion and development, etc.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology with Minimum 60% marks or Equivalent grade from a Recognized University/Institution AND Postgraduate/Master's degree in Engineering/Technology/Energy Planning/Energy Management/Sustainable Energy/Environmental Studies/Environment Science. Minimum 05 years' post-qualification domain experience in MSME.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology/Architecture with Minimum 60% marks or Equivalent grade from a Recognized University/Institution AND Postgraduate/Master's degree in Engineering/Technology/Energy Planning/Energy Management/Sustainable Energy/Environmental Studies/Environment Science. Minimum 5 years' post-qualification domain experience relating to Energy Management/technical evaluation of Energy Saving/compliance with Energy Conservation Building Code (ECBC) & Standards/Building Energy Simulation Software/Green Building Ratings.
rows.desirable: BEE Certified Energy Auditor/Manager, ECBC Master Trainers, CMVP, IGBC/LEED/GRIHA certified professionals preferred. Knowledge in building energy efficiency technologies preferred.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology/Computer Science or allied discipline with Minimum 60% marks or Equivalent grade from a recognized University/Institution AND Postgraduate/Master's degree in Engineering/Technology/Computer Science/AI & ML/Data Analytics. Minimum 05 years' post-qualification domain experience in AI/Data Analytics applications relevant to the energy sector.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology with Minimum 60% marks or Equivalent grade from a Recognized University/Institution AND Postgraduate/Master's degree in Engineering/Technology/Energy Planning/Energy Management/Sustainable Energy/Environmental Studies/Environment Science. Minimum 01 years' post-qualification domain experience in conducting examinations and in Energy Management, auditing, etc.
rows.desirable: Candidates with Valid Gate Scores given preference. BEE Certified Energy Auditor/Manager preferred.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for Personal Interaction as part of the selection process. Mere fulfillment of eligibility criteria does not confer a right to be called for interview.

Visit the Bureau of Energy Efficiency official portal

faq.question: Q1. Is this a permanent job or on contract?
faq.answer: Engagement is purely contractual and co-terminus in nature, with annual renewal considered based on satisfactory performance. It does not confer any right to regularization in BEE or the Government of India.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for Sector Expert and Project Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is not more than 35 years for Sector Expert positions (S&L, ADEETIE, ECSBC/Buildings, and Artificial Intelligence) and not more than 30 years for the Project Engineer (NECA) post, reckoned as on the closing date for receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates selected for these positions?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are called for Personal Interaction as part of the selection process, evaluated by a Screening/Interview Committee.

faq.question: Q4. What are the desirable qualifications mentioned for the posts?
faq.answer: Depending on the post, desirable qualifications include BEE Certified Energy Auditor/Manager, valid GATE scores, ECBC Master Trainers, CMVP, and IGBC/LEED/GRIHA certified professionals.

faq.question: Q5. What documents need to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach two passport-size photographs, educational certificates, domain experience certificates, and BEE Auditor/Manager or valid score cards (if applicable) along with the filled Curriculum Vitae proforma.
